objective: Run and publish Earthquake and the 12 requested scientific workflows sequentially through the AkôFlow daemon and configured Hub connection.
hubScope: Production Hub; exact measured images distributed by immutable aliases at its read-only OCI registry.

workflows.name: Earthquake
workflows.visualPlan: Observed seismic distribution plus aftershock, hazard and gap maps from the completed daemon execution.

workflows.name: SRA Search
workflows.visualPlan: Measured processed, mapped and unmapped read counts, explicitly preserving zero-hit findings.
workflows.finding: 0 reference matches from 2,044,828 processed mates; all full real observations retained in BAM

workflows.name: Variant Calling
workflows.visualPlan: Variant counts by type and genomic position, generated from actual VCF output.

workflows.name: Orcasound
workflows.visualPlan: Spectrogram and detections timeline computed from the selected real hydrophone recording.

workflows.name: SOMOSPIE
workflows.visualPlan: Observed/predicted soil-moisture map and held-out prediction diagnostics.

workflows.name: RNA-seq
workflows.visualPlan: Sample QC, measured alignment metrics and gene-expression summary.

workflows.name: Sarek
workflows.visualPlan: Measured variant summary and genomic distribution from real sequencing inputs.

workflows.name: Viralrecon
workflows.visualPlan: Genome coverage and variant positions from reconstructed viral reads.

workflows.name: MAG
workflows.visualPlan: Actual assembly/bin metrics, contig-length distribution and taxonomic summaries where produced.

workflows.name: Ampliseq
workflows.visualPlan: Read-retention summary and observed taxonomic/community composition.

workflows.name: fMRIPrep
workflows.visualPlan: Anatomical/functional registration and preprocessing quality-control views from actual BIDS outputs.

workflows.name: 1000Genomes
workflows.visualPlan: Observed allele-frequency/variant-overlap distributions for the frozen public cohort subset.

workflows.name: PyCBC / LIGO
workflows.visualPlan: Strain/spectrogram and detection statistic versus time for public GWOSC data.

visualRequirement: Every published workflow must include at least one visual derived from its real computation, with provenance and accessible download.
visualBrowserGate: passed: Earthquake (four original PNGs) and SRA Search (actual-count SVG) rendered in production after AKO-250 deployment 43746068697

productionAssetRegistry.writeAccess: localhost:15000 via SSH only; public routes allow only GET/HEAD

existingMontageVisuals.content: Three band mosaics and a color mosaic from the validated reference execution.
